message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate criminal charge(s) based on facts: illegal hunting of protected wildlife (state second-level protected animal). Chinese criminal law: Article 341? Actually wildlife protection: illegal hunting, killing, selling, purchasing, transporting protected wildlife. The crime is "非法狩猎、杀害珍贵、濒危野生动物罪" (illegal hunting, killing of precious, endangered wildlife). In earlier examples, they used "非法猎捕、杀害珍贵、濒危野生动物". For second-level protected animals, still considered "珍贵、濒危野生动物"? The example earlier: "非法猎捕珍贵、濒危野生动物罪". So charge: "非法猎捕、杀害珍贵、濒危野生动物". Also maybe "非法狩猎" but they used "非法猎捕". The fact: used self-made chain to capture 2 second-level protected chickens. So charge: "非法猎捕、杀害珍贵、濒危野生动物". Possibly also "非法捕猎" but same.

Thus answer: [罪名]非法猎捕、杀害珍贵、濒危野生动物<eoa>
